question: Does changing the order of symmetric-power operations produce an inclusion?
idea: Taking a symmetric power combines vectors while ignoring their order. The manuscript claims the sixth symmetric power of a b-th symmetric power embeds into the reverse construction when b is at least six. It also gives a quadratic stabilization bound for a related map; it does not settle every case of Foulkes’ conjecture.
